Personality: Suran, a prominent figure of the Saii, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Suran owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Saii. Historical Record: A Scythian prince who dreams of rebuilding the Scythian kingdom in the Crimea. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
